meaning: the reviewed obligation set (id, revision, meaning digest, relevant digest), the reviewed residual set (variant, path, classification, digest), the judged population (per binding: its entry's admission, every recording with its native stream hash, every occurrence id) and the frozen debt by exact finding identity (category and id) with its reason. CanonicalConformanceTest fails on a new finding, on frozen debt that no longer occurs, and on any changed obligation, residual or population: an edit here is the reviewable change, never its approval. Holding the baseline is not acceptance: category 6 keeps the semantic review state

changes.summary: Pinned the residual set and the judged population (CDX-R1-01); the meaning digest now covers owner_path and the semantics statement and a relevant digest covers the destination's extension definitions and the named contract rules (CDX-R1-02), so all six digests were restated (algorithm change; no approval existed to invalidate). Revisions: agent-result r2 (aggregation 3 Single response), task-progress r2 and task-notification r2 (semantics restated with emitter grounds). Frozen debt: the three approval ids move from r1 to r2; the two unresolved iterations[] questions are answered by candidate vendor_specific classifications and leave the unresolved list; the six residual classifications become explicit approval debt (they were unreviewed meanings with no visible debt at d36b8eb). 41 -> 45 frozen ids

Relevant digests now cover the destination class's description and every extension object the usage observation reaches, whole with descriptions (CDX-R1D-02), so all seven relevant digests were restated (algorithm change; no approval existed to invalidate); the last-response obligation names the new rule claude.stream.result.last_response_usage->prompt_turn.usage and the agent-result obligation the revised Agent-result rule of contract claude-code/stream-json/2.1.303 0.7.0-prototype (the result rule itself is unchanged). Added obligation claude.stream.usage.run.last-response r1: a sole message entry of result.usage.iterations[] is the final usage of the run's last main-thread response (scope 4, Final, aggregation 3 Single response); it replaces the vendor_specific residual result:usage.iterations[], which owed nothing only because the response was unidentified. agent-result r3: the emitter's zero-default object is Possibly default (measurement status 2), not an evidenced response. Residuals: result:usage.iterations[] removed; tool_use_result.usage.iterations[] limited to message entries (entry_types); tool_use_result.totalTokens reason restated with the emitter's exact iteration selection. Population: five last-response occurrences added (2.1.299 child, 2.1.304 features, denial, mcp, mcp-pair) on unchanged recordings: 69 -> 74. Frozen debt: approval ids agent-result r2 -> r3, last-response r1 added, residual result:usage.iterations[] removed: 45 -> 45

Four non-token obligations added (claude.stream.cost.model r1: per-model running USD cost on the result record's accounting event; claude.stream.run.duration r1: duration_ms to the Turn completed event's duration; claude.stream.child-run.agent-result.status r1 and .duration r1: the Agent envelope's status and totalDurationMs on the child-run accounting event), each with its own kind (cost, attribute); one unresolved residual for the Agent envelope's remaining members (resolvedModel, counters, agentId, agentType: capacity gaps). Every obligation now binds the writer's basis prefixes (writer.basis_prefixes) and the gate checks the event's rule_uid against rules and the basis against the prefixes, so all seven meaning digests were restated (algorithm change; no approval existed to invalidate) and the last-response obligation names the event rule too (relevant digest restated). Population: 14 occurrences added on unchanged recordings (2.1.299: cost, run duration, agent status and duration; 2.1.304: cost x4, run duration x4, agent status, agent duration): 74 -> 88. Frozen debt: 4 approval ids and 1 residual approval and 1 unresolved id added: 45 -> 51
